name: batch_profit_loss
query:
SELECT
  -- REVENUE VIEW, NOT A FULL P/L. `cost_of_goods` is NULL on purpose: a real cost
  -- needs the purchase side (P0.5 opening stock + valuation) and guessing it from
  -- feed invoices would produce a number nobody can reconcile. Until then this
  -- report states what was invoiced, returned and collected per batch.
  bd.batch AS `batch`,
  bd.customer AS `customer`,
  SUM(bd.allocated_amount) AS `invoiced`,
  SUM(bd.returned_amount) AS `returned`,
  SUM(bd.allocated_amount - bd.returned_amount) AS `revenue_net`,
  SUM(bd.offset_amount) AS `netted_by_livestock`,
  SUM(bd.paid_amount) AS `collected`,
  SUM(bd.outstanding_amount) AS `receivable`,
  NULL AS `cost_of_goods`
FROM `tabBatch Debt` bd
WHERE bd.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY bd.batch, bd.customer
ORDER BY `revenue_net` DESC
